name: Akatsuki
tagline: Japan's first Venus orbiter; recovered from a 2010 orbit-insertion failure to study cloud-top dynamics
description: JAXA's Venus Climate Orbiter, Japan's first spacecraft to successfully orbit Venus. Originally failed orbit insertion in 2010 but was recovered on a backup attempt five years later (2015) using less efficient thrusters. Studied cloud-top winds, lightning, and atmospheric dynamics of Venus's super-rotating atmosphere. Mission ended September 2025 after contact was lost.
best_known_for: Japan's first Venus orbiter; studied cloud-top winds and atmospheric dynamics. Recovered after a 2010 orbit-insertion failure
